notes: kb/Work PB5253 landed. §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR1: identifier-1 defined in the Report Section "must reference a sum counter" (kb/Work PB5047: a SOURCE or VALUE entry is refused below 2002, COBOL6764), and with no UPON phrase that counter "must be defined either in the same report group that contains this SUM clause or in a report group which is at a lower level in the control hierarchy of this report". ReportSectionBinder.ScreenRolledAddend asks it: a counter of the SUM entry's own group is the crossfoot RolledRepetitionFault admits below 2002 (kb/Work PB5022); a counter of another group of the same report is asked GroupCombinationPermitted, whose control-footing arm admits only a footing of a lower level of control (SUM itself is confined to a control footing at 85, kb/Work PB5046); and below 2002 a counter of ANOTHER report is refused (COBOL2731), the cross-report admission being §2002:13.16.52.2 SR3 g). Witness: pb5253_sum_counter_of_another_report_refused_at_85 (SUM ATOT OF RPT in RPT2); the 2002 acceptance is cases/13.18.54-SUM/pb5253_sum_counter_of_another_report.

next.reason: Kept: subject not alphabetic (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR2 'shall be valid as the category of a receiving operand in a MOVE statement for a sending operand of the category numeric'), non-report addend numeric (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR5), and no UPON with a report-section addend (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 a). Changed: 1985 requires a Report Section addend to be a sum counter, in the same group or a lower-level control footing; §2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 accepts any 'numeric data item in the report section' and adds pairings ('The current report group may be a detail and data-name-1 may be defined in a different detail', report and page footings, other reports), while a same-group addend now 'shall be a repeating item' with more levels of repetition, so a 1985 non-repeating crossfoot within one control footing is refused. Both looser and stricter; compile-time throughout.
